subject: english
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: A well done introduction grabs the reader.
A wel done introduction grabs the reader.
A well done introduction grabbs the reader.
A well done intrudoction grabs the reader.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **sentence with no spelling error **is:** A well done introduction grabs the reader.**
 
• Here are the **correct versions and meanings** of the incorrectly spelled words from the other sentences:
 
• **Wel **(Incorrectly spelled in sentence 2): **Correct Spelling:** Well: In a good or satisfactory way.(अच्छी तरह से)
 
• **Grabbs** (Incorrectly spelled in sentence 3):**Correct Spelling**: Grabs: To quickly take hold of something.(पकड़ना)
 
• **Intrudoction** (Incorrectly spelled in sentence 4): **Correct Spelling**: Introduction: The action of introducing something.(परिचय)

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *A well done introduction grabs the reader.*
